title: Oozy Spanish Gouda Cheese Tarta De Santiago
description: A traditional Spanish dish from the Basque region, this tarta de Santiago features oozy Gouda cheese and is perfect for a low-calorie meal prep option. It is a fatty and bouncy cheese tart that is boiled to perfection.
instructions: Preheat the oven to 375 degrees Fahrenheit.
In a large bowl, whisk together the flour, eggs, and melted butter to form a dough.
Add the Gouda cheese, salt, and black pepper to the dough and mix until well combined.
Roll out the dough to a thickness of about 1/4 inch and place it in a 9-inch tart pan.
Pour the water into the tart pan and bring to a boil over high heat.
Reduce the heat to low and simmer for 20 minutes, or until the cheese is oozy and the crust is golden brown.
Remove the tarta de Santiago from the heat and let it cool for 10 minutes before serving.
